pose: Extremely compact vertical perch on a slender, sharp limestone pinnacle. The Archaeopteryx is facing the camera, with its wings **folded tightly against its body**, forming a narrow, streamlined silhouette. Its long, feathered tail hangs perfectly straight down, serving as a vertical extension. The head is held high, looking slightly up and positioned at the very top of the 1024px frame. This creates a single, unbroken vertical line of content.

environmental_details.ground: A sharp, narrow pinnacle of cream-colored Solnhofen limestone, reflecting maximum light. The pinnacle is perfectly centered to support the verticality.
environmental_details.flora: Absolutely no flora in the immediate foreground or mid-ground. Only tiny, distant scrub visible on the horizon, well outside the crop zones.
environmental_details.sky: Expansive, brilliant blue sky directly behind the Archaeopteryx, providing high contrast for its silhouette.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Sharp, direct midday sun to highlight the detailed 'soft downy feathers' and the contours of its body, emphasizing its compact form.
